name: LOGIC
description: Logic is a highly strategic deduction-based card game for four players in two teams. It is a game of perfect information (eventually), where players must deduce the identity and position of cards in their opponents' hands. Unlike traditional trick-taking games, 'Logic' is more akin to a competitive version of Mastermind or Hanabi, requiring careful observation of partners' clues and opponents' guesses.

content.text: Logic is a highly strategic deduction-based card game for four players in two teams. It is a game of perfect information (eventually), where players must deduce the identity and position of cards in their opponents' hands. Unlike traditional trick-taking games, 'Logic' is more akin to a competitive version of Mastermind or Hanabi, requiring careful observation of partners' clues and opponents' guesses.
Developed in the late 20th century as a competitive abstract deduction exercise. It gained popularity in programming and mathematics circles as a test of logical inference.
4 players in two fixed partnerships (A+C vs B+D).
24 cards: Ace (low) through Queen (high) of two suits (e.g., Red and Black).
Standard deck and privacy screens for card arrangement.
Each player is dealt 6 cards face-down. They arrange their cards in front of them in **ascending order of value** from left to right.
